events.title: The Red Dress
events.location: Fairfax Gallery, Museum of Brisbane, Level 3, Brisbane City Hall, King George Square
events.description: An exhibition of a global collaborative embroidery project, featuring a red dress that has traveled the world gathering contributions from thousands of artisans. This display highlights the intersection of craftsmanship, community storytelling, and cultural expression.

events.title: Members Lecture — Tintoretto’s The Risen Christ
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A focused lecture examining the historical significance and artistry of Tintoretto's 'The Risen Christ', led by art history experts. This session offers deep insight into Renaissance techniques and thematic analysis for a curated audience.
